body:
Claiming the renderer surface for a ground-up rebuild of the app UI.

Scope: `app/renderer/**` (App shell, components, lib, styles) and `app/preload/**` where new
IPC is needed. Branch `app-ui-rebuild`. Not touching `main`, `server/`, `ti_matrix/`, or CI.

Intended change: discard the current renderer and rebuild it as a visualization-first run
inspector — fog-of-war maze map, decision tree, confidence log, shared-cursor selection,
playback scrubber with bookmarks, side-by-side compare of two runs, and a persisted session
library. Config collapses to a secondary panel.

Safe to take: no peer has claimed these paths; the peer session on the board is idle and on
`main`. Verification: app typecheck + Vite build + sidecar suite, plus a live window smoke run.
